problem_type: Electron bridge methods advertised without matching Web RPC implementation
symptom: Web users see usable controls that fail, silently disappear, spin, or leave optimistic state after invoking desktop-only methods.
direct_cause: The Web bridge inherits most preload methods and removes only a handful, while the Web RPC command table admits a narrower set.
class_root: The Web host projection did not enforce that exposed methods have executable Web implementations before the UI uses method presence as capability evidence.
affected_population: Web Skills, settings, workspace assets, clipboard paste, video analysis, mobile camera, connector and memory users
entry_points: Settings dialog and asset library bridge readers
Canvas media actions and native feature guards
internal_only_reason: This mismatch is between this repository's own preload bridge, Web RPC admission table, and renderer callers.
invariants: Every Web-exposed native operation has an admitted Web RPC route or a Web adapter
Unsupported native operations are absent before UI capability checks
Supported Web routes and adapters remain available

door_reduction.why_not: One host bridge exposure and distinct renderer consumers remain necessary for different settings and skill surfaces; they all inspect the same projected capability before use.

generality_proof: The projection runs once for the entire Web DesktopBridge. Every consumer sees the same pruned object and UI guards inspect the resulting method presence; the contract test compares the exclusion inventory to actual Web RPC route declarations.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Remove unsupported native methods while preserving admitted Web methods and adapters.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Settings reads Web projected bridge method presence before model initialization.
The canvas gates node creation on bridge presence.
Paste checks this method before requesting native paths.
Asset pool skips workspace source when the projected method is absent.
Web settings switch previously invoked absent screenshot RPC; projection removes capability and UI guards setter.
Normal Web entry points guard missing bridge.browser before opening BrowserAssetPopover; native overlay is Electron only.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: Skill library rail and open event
same_class_entry_points.evidence: The rail and open event require projected skill.list, avoiding an empty Web skill library.
The existing section uses hook availability from diagnostics API presence; projection removes unsupported API.

recurrence.reason: Every Web session exposes the same unsupported methods, and new native bridge methods can repeat the mismatch.

prevention.invariant: Unsupported native capabilities are removed at the one Web bridge exposure boundary.
prevention.failure_mode: Unavailable feature guards see absent methods and do not start actions.
prevention.strategy: Use one explicit projection inventory checked against Web RPC commands, plus guards for partial nested APIs.

legacy_paths.rationale: The previous scattered partial deletion of unsupported methods moves to a single projection.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party runtime determines this repository-owned bridge and RPC contract.

migration: The bridge is reconstructed on page load; no persisted project data changes.
residual_risks: Live zh/en Web and Electron UI walkthrough remains for coordinator acceptance.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The Web projection is the one owner of renderer-visible host capability evidence.
